result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but a few elements appear clipped or crowded, suggesting horizontal overflow/carousel and fixed navigation spacing issues.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant list content. The second restaurant card is partially hidden behind the tab bar, making the card feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable items are visibly cut off at the right edge, including the category chip row and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards. The far-right category chip appears as a blank partial pill, which looks visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible carousel items still show enough content to communicate they are scrollable, or add spacing/snap behavior so clipped items do not appear as empty fragments.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' row is truncated at the right edge, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Allow more card width, use proper text truncation with ellipsis, or ensure the card is fully visible when snapped into place.

issues.description: Some secondary gray text, such as delivery fees and metadata, has relatively low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Use a slightly darker gray or stronger font weight to improve readability.
